pr_title: mgmt: mcumgr: grp: img_mgmt: Fix not checking image upload size
pr_body:
Fixes an issue whereby upload image size would not be checked in the first packet of an upload, which would allow an image to be uploaded until it reached the point of it being too large to fit anymore.

and

    mgmt: mcumgr: grp: img_mgmt: Fix not checking write bounds
    
    Fixes an issue whereby the data packets were not checked to ensure
    that the client has not attempted to write more data than the size
    that was provided in the original upload packet.

Fixes #60899

issue_context.title: mgmt: mcumgr: grp: img_mgmt: Upload does not bother to check slot size and silently stops responding
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
It would appear that the size of an image is not checked against the size of the slot, this means an invalid image can be (partially) uploaded to a device, what actually happens is that there will be a point whereby the device responds OK with the next offset, then just stops responding entirely and does not even return an error.
The size of the upload is provided in the start packet so this should never occur.

**To Reproduce**
Upload image that is larger than a slot

**Expected behavior**
Upload to be rejected at the start with an error response

**Impact**
Showstopper

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Commit SHA or Version used: b77d40d1fe4b2fd2bdcc4c640c4388b92999156a

review_comments:
This is good enough, although we probably need some boot API function to round down the size to actually available.
This will give us some problems because we are also able to upload already padded images.
For the application via MCUmgr this should not be a problem because the status is in the primary image slot which will be running (assuming swap using move mode)
